claims.text: Alila Shanghai is at 500 Weihai Road in Shanghai's historic Jing'an district.

findings.quote: 500 Weihai Road, Jing’an District, Shanghai, China 200041
Alila Shanghai places you in the historic Jing’an district

claims.text: The hotel overlooks the historic Zhangyuan Shikumen compound.

findings.quote: a prime location overlooking the historic Zhangyuan Shikumen
findings.note: States the hotel overlooks Zhangyuan Shikumen.

claims.text: The hotel is within walking distance or a short drive of Shanghai Grand Theatre, People's Park and Shanghai Museum, and close to Nanjing Road shopping.

findings.quote: enjoy being within walking distance or a short drive to several Shanghai attractions, such as Shanghai Grand Theatre, People’s Park, Shanghai Museum and more. You’re also close to the bustling shopping street of Nanjing Road
findings.note: All named attractions and Nanjing Road are covered.

claims.text: Alila Shanghai is Alila's first urban outpost in China.

findings.quote: As Alila's first urban outpost in China, it perfectly captures the resort-style hotel concept the brand is known for.

claims.text: Interiors by Beijing-based designer Ju Bin riff on traditional Chinese courtyard homes and the East-meets-West style of old Shanghai's shikumen houses.

findings.quote: -based interior designer Ju Bin saw the amount of rooms reduced from 439 to 186
findings.note: The preceding text names the designer as Beijing-based; it is split across lines in the source.

findings.quote: a fresh look that riffs on traditional Chinese courtyard homes and the East-meets-West style of old Shanghai's shikumen houses

claims.text: Design elements throughout the rooms celebrate Chinese craftsmanship and culture while embodying Shanghai's blend of modernity and tradition.

findings.quote: Design elements throughout Alila Shanghai’s 186 rooms, which include 94 suites, celebrate Chinese craftsmanship and culture while embodying Shanghai’s blend of modernity and tradition.

claims.text: Rooms have natural finishes and a spa-like bathroom with Shanghai-inspired detailing, from textured glass to bold floor tiles.

findings.quote: Enjoy the natural finishes and spa-like bathroom with Shanghai-inspired detailing, from textured glass to bold floor tiles.

claims.text: The Penthouse Suite is on the hotel's highest floor.

findings.quote: opt for the 244 sqm Penthouse Suite King on the hotel’s highest floor
findings.note: Confirms the Penthouse is on the highest floor.

claims.text: Spa Alila blends modern healing therapies with traditional Eastern practices, offering massages, facials, herbal scrubs and body wraps.

findings.quote: skilled therapists tailor a range of innovative treatments, including blissful massages, rejuvenating facials, herbal scrubs and body wraps. Blending modern healing therapies and traditional Eastern practices
findings.note: All treatments and the blend of approaches are covered.

claims.text: A library on the Lobby Level holds a curated collection of books on Shanghai's history and culture.

findings.quote: Within this space on the Lobby Level, a curated collection of books showcase Shanghai’s history and culture

claims.text: 500 Weihai Road is the hotel's Chinese restaurant, integrating seafood into traditional Shanghai cuisine with sustainable, seasonal ingredients.

findings.quote: This Chinese restaurant seamlessly integrates seafood into traditional Shanghai cuisine, placing a strong emphasis on the use of sustainable and seasonal ingredients.
findings.note: This is the description of the 500 Weihai Road restaurant.

claims.text: Secret Roof serves coffee by day and handcrafted coffee cocktails by night, with views of historical Zhangyuan.

findings.quote: Enjoy expertly brewed coffee by day and handcrafted coffee cocktails by night alongside views of historical Zhangyuan at Secret Roof at Alila Shanghai.

claims.text: The fourth-floor lobby is a light-flooded courtyard in the sky, with pathways, waterworks and gardens around a ceramic and stainless steel tree sculpture by local artist Oscar Wang.

findings.quote: the fourth-floor lobby, and you arrive in a light-flooded courtyard in the sky, a mesh of swirling pathways, mirror-flat waterworks, and manicured gardens
surrounding a 17-foot tree made from ceramic and stainless steel by local artist Oscar Wang
findings.note: Identifies the sculpture and its artist.

claims.text: On Level 5, an indoor infinity pool overlooks the hotel's green garden, alongside a hydrotherapy pool and a wet sauna.

findings.quote: On Level 5, a 20-meter infinity pool overlooks the hotel’s green garden. Elsewhere, visitors will discover loungers, a hydrotherapy pool and a wet sauna.

claims.text: Shikumen View rooms overlook Zhangyuan's shikumen rooftops, and one room type adds a private terrace.

findings.quote: Relax in this generous 39-sqm room overlooking Zhangyuan’s shikumen rooftops.
complete with a private terrace for an added touch of uniqueness
findings.note: From the 1 King Bed, Shikumen View, Terrace room type.

claims.text: In-house guests can join a complimentary gong sound bath, one of the hotel's Alila Moments.

findings.quote: slip into sonic stillness during this complimentary gong sound bath
Complimentary for in-house guests
findings.note: Price line for the gong session.

claims.text: Another Alila Moment takes guests to Lei Yun Shang, a Chinese medicine clinic founded in 1734, for a personal consultation with a senior practitioner.

findings.quote: Enter Lei Yun Shang, a renowned TCM clinic founded in 1734, and explore its storied role in healing.
Your visit begins with a personal health consultation by a senior TCM practitioner

claims.text: The hotel no longer provides bottled water or disposable in-room amenities, so guests are advised to bring their own essentials and a drinking vessel.

findings.quote: our hotel no longer provides bottled water or disposable in-room amenities for staying guests. We recommend bringing your own essentials and a drinking vessel

claims.text: Views vary by floor and direction; East-facing rooms on high floors can glimpse The Bund's skyline.

findings.quote: views vary depending on the floor and rooms' direction—aim for an East-facing room on a high floor if you want a glimpse of The Bund's
findings.note: The text continues with 'Blade Runner skyline on the horizon'.

claims.text: Guests must wear a swimming cap in the pool.

findings.quote: you'll need to wear a swimming cap before jumping in
